language.label: Site language
copy-title: Shokz Refill — Your audio, ready to go.
copy-hero-kicker: For Shokz with USB MP3 storage
copy-hero-body: Your next playlist. Your next chapter. Prepare your headphones on your computer, then take your audio with you.
copy-captures: The real app, with fictional demonstration data. Click a screenshot to enlarge it.
copy-spec-portable-body: No Python or FFmpeg to install
copy-overview-title: One place to prepare everything you listen to.
copy-overview-body: Music, audiobooks and local MP3s share the same device, with dedicated screens to keep things clear.
copy-music-title: Choose the songs. Keep their order.
copy-music-body: Search songs and playlists, then use + to build your send list. It stays with you as you browse. Send to Shokz opens a review of the songs and destination before anything downloads.
copy-music-account-body: In Settings, click Connect next to YouTube Music. Open your browser, sign in and return to the app to import the session. Then open My playlists. Public search works without an account.
copy-books-title: One book. One folder. Numbered chapters.
copy-books-body: Connect your Audiobookshelf server in Settings. Select books and choose Send to Shokz: each chapter becomes a numbered MP3, copied in playback order. Available chapter metadata is used when valid; otherwise the source-file order is preserved.
copy-files-body: Choose your detected Shokz or use Browse… to select its mounted folder. Create folders, rename and move files. Add MP3 imports local music: compatible files copy directly, others are converted to the target format without changing your originals.
copy-files-tip: Deletion asks for confirmation. Name conflicts preserve both files. Recovery tools are in the overflow menu.
copy-transfers-body: Follow downloads, conversion and copies in Transfers. Use Cancel selected for active or queued items, or Retry selected after a failure or cancellation. The sidebar indicator stays visible on every screen.
copy-transfers-tip: Interrupted copies remain distinguishable from complete MP3s. Reconnect the same device before retrying or resuming.
copy-voice-body: Optional Piper announcements run offline, with eight bundled voices across French, English, German, Dutch and Spanish. Set separate text for the first and later chapters. Default speed is 100%, followed by 1.5 seconds of silence.
copy-voice-template: Use $book_name, $author_name, $chapter_number and $chapter_title. Try Preview, then Save settings. Changes apply to books queued afterwards.
copy-ui-language: The desktop interface is in English. The guide keeps the actual button names so you can find them easily.
copy-guide-title: From your first click to your next swim.
copy-guide-intro: For music, a send list keeps you in control of the tracks, playback order and destination.
copy-step1-body: Connect the headphones by USB. In Shokz files, select the mounted device or use Browse…. Check the name and available space in the sidebar.
copy-step2-body: Search in YouTube Music or open My playlists. Use + beside a song or playlist. Your list keeps its order across searches; adding an item does not start a download.
copy-step3-body: Choose Send to Shokz. Reorder or remove songs, then click Next. Select an existing folder or create one, and click Send.
copy-step4-body: Open Transfers to watch progress or retry a failed item. Wait until all operations finish, then eject the headphones through your operating system before unplugging them.
copy-order-caption: Review the songs and their playback order.
copy-folder-caption: Choose where the music goes before starting.
copy-tour-kicker: A little help to get started
copy-tour-title: Let the app show you around.
copy-tour-body: A nine-step guided tour opens the first time the app is launched. It highlights the actual controls, without needing an account or connected device. Skip it at any time, or reopen Guided tour above Settings in the sidebar.
copy-tour-context: Closing the tour returns you to your previous page. Your send list stays in place.
copy-download-body: Download the portable executable for your computer. Python, Qt, FFmpeg, Piper and the voice models are included.
copy-release-note: This guide follows the current app. Check the release notes for the features included in the version you download.
copy-linux: Download Shokz-Refill-linux-x86_64, make it executable and launch it.
copy-windows: Download and launch Shokz-Refill-windows-x86_64.exe. No separate runtime installation is needed.
copy-faq-intro: A few things to know about your files, your headset and your accounts.
copy-faq-device-a: Shokz models with USB MP3 storage, including OpenSwim Pro. Unknown volume names can be selected manually. Numbered filenames and sequential copies help preserve playback order; behaviour depends on the model and firmware.
copy-faq-duplicate-q: What happens if I send something twice?
copy-faq-duplicate-a: Recognised identical tracks and exports are skipped. Unidentified files and filename conflicts are preserved. A book with different sources or announcement settings gets a separate export folder.
copy-faq-offline-a: YouTube Music and Audiobookshelf need access to their services. Local MP3 import and Piper announcements work offline. Account sessions are stored locally; Disconnect or Disconnect / forget removes the saved app credentials.
copy-faq-limit-q: Can I transfer a long audiobook?
copy-faq-limit-a: Books are split into numbered chapter MP3s, with a conservative 4 GiB limit per output file. Keep enough free space on your computer for the sources and conversion cache, and on the headphones for the result.
copy-support-body: If Shokz Refill is useful to you, you can buy me a coffee. Sharing the app, reporting bugs and starring the repository help too.
